input.quote: Client hereby grants to TrueLink the nonexclusive worldwide right and license to use, distribute, disseminate, license, resell, exploit, upload, display, copy and store Credit Data subject to the limitations set forth in and in accordance with the Non-Competition Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 8(d) grants TrueLink a worldwide licence to distribute, disseminate, license, resell and exploit our borrower Credit Data — independent exploitation of Customer Data going far beyond processing to provide the Services, which is walk-away territory under this rule and is not cured by any ownership statement elsewhere. The Agreement also contains no ownership or assignment of work product created for us (the Support Services results are only treated as Client Proprietary Information under Section 10) and no statement that we retain rights in Client Content and Credit Data or that nothing is jointly owned. TrueLink's retention of its own platform IP in Section 2(d) is acceptable and is preserved. We therefore narrow the Credit Data licence to service delivery and add the short preferred ownership clause.

mappings.element: Customer owns Deliverables and work product created for Customer.
Vendor assigns the Deliverables and work product to Customer.
Vendor retains its pre-existing intellectual property.
mappings.quote: d. Ownership. Notwithstanding the license granted under section 2.1, TrueLink retains all of its ownership and license rights in the Interface.

mappings.element: Customer's licence to Vendor IP embedded in Deliverables is perpetual.
Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is irrevocable.
Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is royalty-free.
Customer retains all rights in Customer Data.
Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
The parties do not jointly own intellectual property.

proposal.summary: Narrow TrueLink's Credit Data licence to service delivery and add a Client ownership/assignment clause with a licence back to embedded TrueLink IP.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot grant TrueLink rights to distribute, license, resell or otherwise exploit our borrower Credit Data, so we have limited that licence to processing the data solely to provide the Hosting and Support Services to us. We have also added the standard ownership clause: we own work product created for us (TrueLink assigning it), TrueLink keeps its Interface with a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to any of its IP embedded in that work product, we retain all rights in our content and data, and nothing is jointly owned.

ops.oldText: Client hereby grants to TrueLink the nonexclusive worldwide right and license to use, distribute, disseminate, license, resell, exploit, upload, display, copy and store Credit Data subject to the limitations set forth in and in accordance with the Non-Competition Agreement.
ops.newText: Client hereby grants to TrueLink the nonexclusive worldwide right and license to process, upload, display, copy and store Credit Data solely to provide the Hosting and Support Services to Client, subject to the limitations set forth in and in accordance with the Non-Competition Agreement.

ops.text: Client Ownership. Client owns all deliverables and work product created for Client under this Agreement, including all results of the Support Services, and TrueLink hereby assigns such deliverables and work product to Client. TrueLink grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to any TrueLink Intellectual Property embedded in such deliverables and work product. Client retains all right, title and interest in Client Content, Client's Intellectual Property and Credit Data. No intellectual property will be jointly owned by the parties.
